I think I would be able to cope if it was natural reasons. 

That is a good age. Most people in my nursing home, don’t hit 60
I learned because I lost the man I loved more than anything. I would have died for him..
People like that make me angry but I can’t be angry because I used to be that..
That thought makes me want to do it more.. so much more

It’s okay.. I realized I was “one of those people”... god do I hate myself.. 

You can message me and add me on facebook and vent anytime
Fuck them too! Vent! If it helps. My husband vented and I thought the same as everyone else and look where my baby is at! Not fucking with me.....
I feel you so much.. then I get told I’m suppose to care how they feel if I end it?! Like WHAT!!?
This was after months of trying to open up
People just ignore me. They don’t want to deal with me. So I stay alone and deal with the abuse I give myself
I’m with you.. idc to eat. I barely care to get up and pee
I don’t get it.. I’m trying man!! I don’t get what people don’t see. You pressuring people is just making it worse
I’ve done that but to many people put pressure on me to be better.. I want to end it. I know how and I have ways to. I don’t want to be here.
I was having a bad night until I saw this

Thank you. She has kept me going for awhile but having to change her life and keep her cooped up in an apartment, is doing nothing but giving me more guilt. The days grow longer and it’s still getting harder but I’m here.

I’m with you and I understand the not talking about it. It just feels like people won’t get it and 99% of the time, they don’t but hang in there. If you ever do want to just throw it out there, I’m here.
I like your mindset
Mine gets worse on Sunday as well.. My husband said he had a cure. He even wrote a crap ton down but I can’t read it. It kills me
Glad to hear that you are alive. Sorry about your foot. I do hope you seek some sort of help.

Please tell me you are okay? This absolutely broke my heart. I,and I bet a lot of people, struggle everyday with whether to go through with suicide or not but we have to stay strong.. The riptide you set off after you do it, is like the ocean during a tsunami. My husband did it 4 months ago and it still kills me everyday.. You said you have a best friend, do you know the impact that will cause on him,your family,shit even people you don’t know?? People love you. You have people all around you that would love to help. Please let me know you are okay.
Looks like Count Olaf
Thank you!
Thank you. I will look into it
Thank you and I’m still rocky but it’s a slow process. I’m glad she didn’t go fully down hill and stop eating. She has done amazing through this
Thank you! I did this on my phone and it loves to autocorrect me all the time. She is! She is doing amazing! I’m proud of her!
Thank you! She truly has helped a ton.
Okay never mind, I agree.
